statusLine.command: jq -r '[(.model.display_name // empty), (.context_window.used_percentage // empty | "ctx:" + (round|tostring) + "%"), ([(.rate_limits.five_hour // empty | select(.used_percentage != null) | "5h:" + (.used_percentage|round|tostring) + "%" + (if .resets_at != null then "(→" + (.resets_at|floor|strflocaltime("%H:%M")) + ")" else "" end)), (.rate_limits.seven_day // empty | select(.used_percentage != null) | "7d:" + (.used_percentage|round|tostring) + "%")] | if length > 0 then join(" ") else empty end)] | join("  ")'
